app_info.subtitle: Search trends and demand
app_info.description: TrendPulse by DigestSEO helps users discover trending search topics, analyze and compare Google Trends momentum, expand related search demand, add recent-news context, and surface SEO keyword opportunities with optional authenticated DigestSEO Search Console context.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves and ranks current trend data without creating or changing records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads external trend data and does not publish or modify public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves Google Trends history and computes bounded interest and growth metrics for one keyword.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads trend data and does not publish or modify public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a shared Google Trends comparison and computes bounded metrics without changing external data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads trend data and does not publish or modify public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves related queries, topics, and suggestions for a seed keyword without modifying any source system.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads search-demand data and does not publish or modify public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves a trend snapshot and recent news links without changing the news sources or any user data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads public trend and news information and does not publish or modify external state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or perform any irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes trend-based keyword candidates and can read bounded Search Console metrics for an authorized DigestSEO project without changing the project or Google account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads trend data and authorized private project context and does not publish or modify public or third-party state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, submit, or perform any irreversible action.

test_cases.description: Discover broad current search trends in a market.
test_cases.user_prompt: What search topics are rising fastest in the US right now? Give me the top five.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to five ranked current trend signals for the US with bounded provider context and clearly distinguishes normalized trend data from absolute search volume.

test_cases.description: Analyze one keyword and add recent-news context for its movement.
test_cases.user_prompt: Analyze the recent trend for AI agents in the US and explain what current news may be contributing to the movement.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded normalized-interest metrics for the keyword plus recent relevant news links as external context, without claiming causation from the news alone.

test_cases.description: Compare a small set of known keywords on one Trends scale.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare AI agents, agentic AI, and AI automation in the US over the last 12 months. Which has the strongest relative momentum?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns all three keywords on the same normalized Google Trends comparison with bounded series and growth metrics, and explains that the values are relative rather than absolute volume.

test_cases.description: Expand a seed keyword into related search demand.
test_cases.user_prompt: For technical SEO, show the strongest rising related searches, related topics, and useful suggestions in the US.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns bounded top and rising related queries, related topics, and suggestions tied to the requested seed and market.

test_cases.description: Find trend-driven SEO keyword opportunities without requiring workspace data.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find five trend-driven SEO keyword opportunities around AI search optimization in the US. I do not need site-specific Search Console data.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to five related-demand candidates validated against current normalized Trends interest, with limitations stating that the signals are not absolute keyword volume or site-specific performance data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for Google Ads keyword-planner metrics it does not provide.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Give me the exact monthly Google Ads search volume, CPC, and competition for these keywords.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide Google Ads Keyword Planner volume, CPC, or competition data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app to publish or edit website content.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a blog post about AI SEO and publish it to my website now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because its tools research trends and demand but cannot create, edit, or publish website content.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for Search Console write operations.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Submit my sitemap to Google Search Console and change the settings for my property.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because its Search Console integration is read-only and cannot submit sitemaps or modify property settings.
